result.instructions: Grounded material for tutoring the coolmaths puzzles at https://orsenthil.github.io/cut-the-knot/ — browser ports of Alexander Bogomolny's cut-the-knot.org applets. Prefer get_game and explain_concept over your own recollection of a puzzle: the text they return is the site's own explanation. Use run_game_logic to compute a real answer from the game's actual code rather than working one out in prose, and show the result. The tutor prompt is Socratic by design: let the learner play and guess before naming the invariant.
